convention_notes: Q14 — All renames use prepend dd- prefix for namespace consistency, traceability via git grep, and trivial reversibility
Q15 — IDs sharing names with classes (id='layout-menu', id='layout-navbar') renamed alongside classes for full DOM namespace consistency
Q16 — menu-content and text-menu-icon definitively removed from S7 scope (0 occurrences in entire codebase)
Q17/Q18 — Comments referencing technical class/ID names are renamed for documentation consistency. Blade {{-- --}} comments are NOT touched (server-stripped, invisible in prod)
Q19 — Audit scope for any future HTML class rename must extend to JSON config, PHP returning HTML fragments, JS injecting HTML via templating - lesson from L4/L5 visual bug
data_attributes_excluded: Per Q12, all data-* attributes (data-template, data-bs-theme, data-skin, etc.) are HORS scope S7 - they are Sneat-JS internal conventions, not CSS classes.
vendor_libs_excluded: Third-party libraries under resources/assets/vendor/libs/ are excluded by design (Bootstrap, jQuery, Swiper, Apex, etc.). Bootstrap classes and icon classes (ti ti-*, bx bx-*) are NOT in the dd- namespace.

reversibility.rule: Q14 prepend convention enables trivial reversal
reversibility.revert_replacement_hint: Strip the dd- prefix to restore Sneat names. Useful in case of vendor template upgrade requiring re-application of this rename.
reversibility.note: git grep '\bdd-' lists the entire Dream Digital namespace introduced by S7
